title: processkit lock result data
description: The data member of the cli@v1 result envelope for processkit lock and processkit lock --update, also with --dry-run (inheritance@v1 PK-INH-020, PK-INH-057). The plan and changes members of the envelope are those of cli@v1.

upstreams.description: Every lock entry that the run adds, re-resolves to another commit, or removes, sorted by name. Entries that stay the same are not listed.

previousCommit.description: Commit in the current lock; null when the entry is new.

commit.description: Commit in the new lock; null when the entry is removed.

itemList.description: Typed names (<kind>/<name> or <kind>/<namespace>/<name>), sorted in ascending Unicode code point order, each at most once.
